_meta.what: A SECOND AUTOMATED OPINION, not ground truth and not section 5 validation.
_meta.who: Claude, the same system that wrote vibe_scorer.py, having already read vibes-auto.json.
_meta.why_it_is_not_validation: Agreement between this file and vibes-auto.json measures whether two passes by the same rater, over the same BGG knowledge, land in the same place. It cannot tell you the model matches how these games feel at your table. A low MAE here does NOT license section 5's 'trust the auto scores on unplayed games'.
_meta.what_it_is_good_for: Finding games where even the same rater disagrees with the tag model. Those are the rows worth your attention first when you fill in the real worksheet.
_meta.low_confidence_note: Games I do not know well enough to score from play. Treat these five as noise.
_meta.supersede: vibes-manual.json is yours and stays empty until you fill it. Nothing here feeds the UI.
